crossRefs.note: and he said, “Listen, all Judah, and you inhabitants of Jerusalem, and you, king Jehoshaphat. Yahweh says to you…
“Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth…
“Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he. I am the first. I am also the last.
Hear Yahweh’s word, you children of Israel; for Yahweh has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there…
“Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against…
I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
Death will be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places…
“At that time,” says Yahweh, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.”
“Don’t consider what this people has spoken, saying, ‘Has Yahweh cast off the two families which he chose?’ Thus they…
“You, son of man, take one stick, and write on it, ‘For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions.’ Then…
Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.
Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the…

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Hear this word that Yahweh has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:
